title: The Minister on Horseback
sentences: A minister on horseback urged the crowd to go ahead with a hanging.
On August 19th, 1692, the condemned included a former minister, George Burroughs.
His calm prayer on the gallows moved the crowd, and one account says they nearly stopped it.
After Burroughs was hanged, the Boston minister Cotton Mather spoke from his horse.
According to the critic Robert Calef, Mather warned them the Devil often appears as an angel of light.
Four more people were hanged that day.
